data.body: **[P2] Make the pending-byte estimate cover opaque objects.** After `sys.getsizeof()` fails, traversal stops, and objects using `__slots__` are never traversed. A transformed value can therefore wrap a payload larger than 16 MB while being counted only as a small shell; a blocked lane retains it and `deepcopy` may duplicate it, defeating the advertised memory bound and potentially exhausting Lambda memory. Traverse slots/referents even after shallow-size failure, or conservatively reject values whose retained graph cannot be bounded, with regression tests for both cases.
